rule: PROTOCOL.md Layout date tiers: 1 Bayesian start boundary (none published for any town), 2 calibrated start from site radiocarbon, 3 excavator's cross-dated start; AMENDMENT-1.md for plan-based towns
years: D_year is an astronomical year: 2500 BCE = -2499
intcal: IntCal20 (Reimer et al. 2020, Radiocarbon 62: 725-757); D_14C_year is the median calendar age of the oldest layout-phase determination

parts.part: whole site (building complex around the central court)
parts.layout_phase: the 'major construction period' of Buildings I, II, III and probably IV; the radiocarbon list calls the dated level 'Building Level I'

parts.part: citadel (acropolis or 'inner fort' in the south-west of the walled town)
parts.layout_phase: Period IC (transitional, 'proto-Harappan') in the excavator's final scheme (IAR 1986-87, 1987-88); Period II (Mature Indus) in his earlier reports (Bisht 1982; IAR 1983-84)

parts.part: lower town (outer walled town to the east and north of the citadel, with radial or semi-radial streets)
parts.layout_phase: Period IC (transitional) in the excavator's final scheme (IAR 1986-87, 1987-88); Period II in his earlier reports (Bisht 1982; IAR 1983-84)

parts.part: pre-Harappan walled settlement (Period IB), reused by the citadel
parts.layout_phase: Period IB (pre-Harappan, Kalibangan culture, 'defence phase')

towns.date_part: lower town (outer walled town to the east and north of the citadel, with radial streets)
towns.date_source: The excavator's final scheme (IAR 1986-87, 1987-88) assigns the citadel and lower town to Period IC, for which no date or radiocarbon exists; his earlier attribution to Period II (from c. 2300 BC) is superseded. No date under the rule.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: whole town (citadel and lower town within one fortification)
parts.layout_phase: Period IIA, Early Mature Harappan (Rao et al. 2005, 2006), the 'Period II: Transitional' of the 2003-04 report

parts.part: Mound II: fired-brick town of Mackay's Harappa II occupation (streets exposed in 1935-36)
parts.layout_phase: Harappa II occupation (Mackay 1943), Chanhu-daro Ib in Piggott's reclassification as reported by Wheeler

parts.part: Mounds II and III: mud-brick planned town of the first Indus period (French mission, Excavations 2 and 3 and Trench 1, 2015-2022)
parts.layout_phase: First Indus period (Phase 1), 2600/2500-2300 BCE (French Archaeological Mission in the Indus Basin)

parts.part: Mound I: massive mud-brick retaining wall with an exterior facing of fired brick (French mission, 2023-2025)
parts.layout_phase: not stated in the abstract we could read

towns.date_part: Mound II: fired-brick town of Mackay's Harappa II occupation
towns.date_source: No radiocarbon from the Harappa II town. Tier 3: Mackay's own date for the Harappa culture levels, 3000-2600 BC by cross-dating (letter of 1936 quoted in Mackay 1943 p. 253). The French mission dates a mud-brick planned town below these levels to 2600/2500-2300 BCE, which places Harappa II later still; that town is a different part.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: whole town (single stone-walled enclosure, about 130 by 100 m)
parts.layout_phase: Sub-period IA (mature Harappan) of Period I, by inference: the report describes the fortification without assigning it to a sub-period

parts.part: castle (eastern, higher subdivision of the citadel)
parts.layout_phase: Stage I (first fortification); made into the 'castle' and given its monumental gates in Stage III (IIIA)

parts.part: bailey (western subdivision of the citadel)
parts.layout_phase: Stage IIIA

parts.part: ceremonial ground (the 'stadium', multipurpose ground or great ground between the citadel and the middle town)
parts.layout_phase: Stage IIIA

parts.part: middle town
parts.layout_phase: Stage IIIA

parts.part: outer fortification (city wall enclosing all divisions)
parts.layout_phase: Stage IIIA; extended eastward in Stage IIIB

parts.part: lower town
parts.layout_phase: Stage IIIB

parts.part: annexe (built-up area south of the castle along the southern city wall)
parts.layout_phase: Stage III (sub-stage not stated)

towns.date_part: castle (eastern, higher subdivision of the citadel)
towns.date_source: Both imagery measurers' main systems are the castle. The dating record gives its layout phase as Stage I (first fortification), c. 3000-2900 BCE by stratigraphy and ceramic cross-dating (Bisht 2015: 104); tier 3. The castle was remodelled with monumental gates in Stage III (c. 2800-2500 BCE). Sengupta et al. 2020 dated carbonates from all stages, but only the abstract was available.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: settlement area (Locality 1 of the main mound; Central, East, North and Northwest Areas)
parts.layout_phase: Period IIA (Mature Harappan), Structural Phase-1, in the final report of 2011; the 2008 interim report (Occasional Paper 6) assigned the exposed street plan to Structural Phase II, 'Late Period II'

towns.date_part: settlement area (Locality 1 of the main mound)
towns.date_source: Tier 2: Shinde 2023 dates Periods IIA and IIB together to 2600-2400 BCE 'on the basis of a few AMS dates'; the 2011 report puts the town plan in Period IIA.

parts.part: whole town (Mounds A and B)
whole town: the fortified enclosure in the northern half of the mound (the southern part, outside the wall, was also inhabited)
parts.layout_phase: Phase II (Urban/Mature Harappan) of the M. S. University of Baroda sequence, Stage I of the wall

towns.date_source: No calendar start is published for Phase II, in which the wall was built; the regional synthesis of Abhayan et al. 2025 brackets BSR I and II together in c. 2600-2200 BCE. No date under the rule.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: Mound AB (citadel): first perimeter wall
parts.layout_phase: Period 2 (Kot Diji, Early Harappa Phase)

parts.part: Mound AB (citadel): Harappan-phase fortification wall (Wheeler's defences)
parts.layout_phase: Period 3A (Harappa Phase A) in HARP's scheme; the first of Wheeler's three structural periods of the defences

parts.part: Mound E: north-west perimeter (revetment) walls
parts.layout_phase: Period 2 (Kot Diji Phase) in HARP's current scheme; in the 1991 scheme their construction opens Period 2 ('Early Harappan / massive mud-brick revetment walls', Kenoyer 1991: 40, Table 4.2)

parts.part: Mound E: southern and eastern perimeter wall with the south gateway
parts.layout_phase: Period 3A (Harappa Phase A), 'at the very beginning of the Harappan phase'

parts.part: Mound ET: perimeter wall and south-east gateway
parts.layout_phase: Early in the Harappan occupation of Mound ET, after ca. 2470 B.C. (Meadow and Kenoyer 1997); Period 3B in Kenoyer 2008

parts.part: Mound F: perimeter wall and Great Hall ('granary')
parts.layout_phase: Period 3B (Harappa Phase B)

towns.date_part: Mound F: perimeter wall and Great Hall ('granary')
towns.date_source: Both imagery measurers' main systems lie on Mound F. Tier 2: HARP's Period 3B begins 'ca. 2450 BC' in calibrated radiocarbon years (Kenoyer and Meadow 2010: xlv); the start is given without a range, so sigma is 150 years. Meadow and Kenoyer 2005 give 'c. 2450/2400'.

parts.part: whole town (fortified citadel, ceremonial ground with two 'stadiums', lower town, within an outer fortification)
parts.layout_phase: Period I (Mature Harappan, 'with sub-phases'); the excavator assigns the architecture to Period I but gives no structural phase for the first building of the walls

parts.part: citadel (KLB-1, western mound: two walled rhombs on the ruins of the Period I settlement)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Harappan, Kalibangan II), earlier of the two principal structural phases of the citadel fortification

parts.part: lower town (KLB-2, eastern mound: walled lower city with street grid)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Harappan), first of nine Harappan structural phases: the city wall and the street grid were laid out at the very beginning of the Harappan occupation

parts.part: Period I walled settlement (beneath and partly reused by the KLB-1 citadel)
parts.layout_phase: Period I (Early Harappan, also called pre-Harappan, 'Sothi' or Kalibangan I): fortification wall in two structural phases

towns.date_part: lower town (KLB-2, eastern mound: walled lower city with street grid)
towns.date_source: Plan main systems are the KLB-2 street grid. Tier 2: the excavation team's latest statement, Part II (2020) p. 1423, gives Period II as 'circa 2600 to circa 1900 B.C.' from calibrated radiocarbon (also Lal 2003 p. 27, 'commencing around 2600 BC').

parts.part: whole town: the fortified main mound (the excavators found no lower town)
parts.layout_phase: KMR IIa, the first sub-phase of KMR II (Mature Harappan, 'urban phase'); IAR 2006-07 calls the same unit Period II

towns.date_part: whole town: the fortified main mound
towns.date_source: Tier 2: the excavators' AMS dates bracket the urban phase, beginning with KMR IIa, 'between 2500 and 2000 BC' (Kharakwal et al. 2011 p. 368).
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: fortified settlement (Area A: town wall with a north-western corner bastion)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Mature Harappan); the excavators attribute the fortification to the arrival of the Harappans after a thin transitional phase, without tying it to one of the three Mature Harappan stages

parts.part: Area E street and house-blocks (north-east of Area A)
parts.layout_phase: Harappan phase (transitional and Mature Harappan); the street existed through at least five structural phases

parts.part: whole town: the outer fortification enclosing about 310 x 270 m
parts.layout_phase: first construction phase of the main fortification (the original wall, 3.40 m thick), within the Mature Harappan occupation; the excavators do not say in print which of the site's five structural phases it belongs to

parts.part: citadel on the southern side, inside the general fortification
parts.layout_phase: second structural phase (of five), within Phase 1A of pokharia2017khirsara

parts.part: factory area north of the citadel, with its own fortification
parts.layout_phase: the phase after the 'early phase' structures (IAR 2012-13); IAR 2010-11 says the main factory structure was built in the second phase

parts.part: citadel mound (Area A): defensive wall of the Kot Dijian settlement
parts.layout_phase: Kot Diji culture levels, layers (16) to (4); the wall was 'raised on bed-rock' at the start of this sequence

parts.part: citadel mound (Area A): Mature Harappan settlement with lanes
parts.layout_phase: Harappa culture levels, layers (3A) to (1); layer (3) is 'the earliest Harappan settlement' and layer (2) 'the principal Harappan settlement'

parts.part: outer city (Area B, east of the citadel)
whole settlement (square stone settlement wall with bastions and the central residential complex)
parts.layout_phase: the single Harappan (Sorath-type, Late Mature) occupation; the excavators' report, in press, has not been seen, and no sub-phases are published

parts.part: citadel mound fortification (whole settlement)
parts.layout_phase: Period I (Mature Harappan); the structural phase within Period I is not stated in the sources we read

parts.part: whole town (mounds A-D and the western mound, Sukkur Industrial and Trading Estate)
parts.layout_phase: Mature Indus or Harappa phase (no layout phase defined by the excavators)

parts.part: acropolis
parts.layout_phase: Period A, Phase IIa (first sub-phase of structural Phase II)

parts.part: lower town
parts.layout_phase: Period A, Phase IIa (first sub-phase of structural Phase II)

parts.part: dock
parts.layout_phase: Period A, Phase IIa (first sub-phase of structural Phase II)

parts.part: peripheral wall
parts.layout_phase: Period A, Phase I (mud-bund), raised and reinforced in Phase IIa

towns.date_source: Tier 3: Phase IIa starts c. 2350 BC by Rao's cross-dating and count of building phases back from uncalibrated radiocarbon (Rao 1979; restated by Frenez and Tosi 2005). Possehl and Raval 1989 calibrate the Lothal A dates to a Harappan settlement of Gujarat c. 2500-2300 BC, which dates Phase I as a whole rather than the dock.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: whole town (twin mounds Mitathal 1 and Mitathal 2, trenches MTL-1 and MTL-2)
parts.layout_phase: Period IIA (Harappan), from the end of its structural phase 2 (structural phases 3 to 5 of Period IIA)

parts.part: citadel (western or 'Stupa' mound): mud-brick platform
parts.layout_phase: Beginning of the Intermediate III phase, between Strata 6 and 7 (Marshall); 'Intermediate Period' (Wheeler 1950 excavation)

parts.part: citadel perimeter: mud-brick 'bund' or city wall at the western foot of the citadel (Wheeler's 1950 cutting west of the Granary, reopened in 2025-26 as trench MD25)
parts.layout_phase: First city wall, end of the Early Harappan or Kot Diji phase (Kenoyer, Ibrahim and Lashari 2026); built 'at a relatively early date' in the citadel's history (Wheeler)

parts.part: lower town (DK-G, HR and VS areas): street grid
parts.layout_phase: Intermediate III phase, the lowest level at which the street grid has been exposed (Mackay 1938, who reassigns Intermediate III to the end of the Early Period)

towns.date_part: lower town (DK-G, HR and VS areas): street grid
towns.date_source: No radiocarbon from the layout phase. Tier 3: Mackay 1938 dates the lowest attainable levels of the grid to c. 2800 BC by cross-dating (range 2800-2500). Jansen 1987 models a foundation about 2400 BC and Kenoyer 1998 dates urban Mohenjo-daro from about 2600 BC; neither is the excavator's dated layout phase, so they are recorded as disagreements.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: south tepe: Period II Indus settlement (enclosure wall with gate, street-bounded block)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (first Indus occupation)

parts.part: north tepe: Period II monumental building and platform-wall over the Period ID enclosure
parts.layout_phase: Period II (first Indus occupation), on structures of Period ID

parts.part: whole settlement (south and north tepe): Period III blocks and perpendicular streets
parts.layout_phase: Period III (second Indus occupation)

parts.part: citadel (RGR-2)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Mature Harappan), its first structural phase: 'Phase 1' of five tentative Mature Harappan levels in Nath 1998; 'phase-IV', the first phase of Period II, in Nath 2014

parts.part: RGR-1 (habitation mound north of RGR-3)
parts.layout_phase: Period I (Early Harappan), structural phase 2 (IAR 1998-99; 'phase II', sub-phases IIa and IIb, in Nath 2014), within sub-period I(b) 'formative urbanism'; Nath 1999 numbers the same planned phase 'Phase-I'

parts.part: RGR-6 (Arda; separate Early Harappan mound)
parts.layout_phase: Period I(b), formative urbanism (structural phases 4 to 6 in IAR 1999-2000; the 2014 report singles out phase V)

parts.part: RGR-4 and RGR-5 (southern mounds under Rakhi Khas and Rakhi Shahpur)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Mature Harappan); no structural phase stated

parts.part: whole town (Mature Harappan city, RGR-1 to RGR-5)
parts.layout_phase: Period II (Mature Harappan)

parts.part: excavated area of the Harappan settlement (house platforms and drains)
parts.layout_phase: Sub-period II A, structural Phase I (first of the four structural phases of II A)

towns.date_part: excavated area of the Harappan settlement
towns.date_source: No radiocarbon from Rangpur. Tier 3: Rao 1963 dates the first Harappan structural phase of II A to c. 2000 BC by cross-dating with Lothal; later syntheses move II A earlier on ceramic grounds without dates from the site.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record

parts.part: circumvallation and gateway (whole settlement)
parts.layout_phase: Rojdi C, 'possibly the early part of this period' (Possehl and Raval's ceramic phase)

parts.part: main mound house platform (1957-63 excavations)
parts.layout_phase: Period I, Phase A (Pandya and Nanavati)

towns.date_source: The plan main system, a Subphase 2b building on the Main Mound, does not match a dated part, so Amendment 1 takes the earliest walled part: the circumvallation, Rojdi C, 2000-1700 BC on calibrated radiocarbon (Possehl and Raval 1989 pp. 11-13, 171).

parts.part: inner fortified settlement: the whole town inside the mud-brick fortification wall
parts.layout_phase: Phase I of the M. S. University of Baroda excavations (2007-08 onward), Classical Harappan, urban phase

parts.part: outer fortification wall on the southern side and the habitation between the inner and outer walls
parts.layout_phase: Phase I (Classical Harappan), built after the first spread of habitation in the southern part of the site

parts.part: citadel (western, higher enclosure)
parts.layout_phase: Sub-period IA (Period I in the 1970-71 report); the stone rampart, bastions and gateway complex exposed today are the Sub-period IC rebuilding on the same line

parts.part: residential annexe (lower, eastern enclosure; 'lower city' in the 1970-71 report)
parts.layout_phase: Sub-period IA; rebuilt in stone in Sub-period IC on the same line

towns.date_source: Tier 2: Possehl and Raval 1989 (p. 10) calibrate the Surkotada and Lothal dates and place the Harappan settlement of Kutch c. 2500-2300 BC; the start is stated as a range, so D is its midpoint and sigma a quarter of its width. Joshi's own figures (2055-1970 BC) are uncalibrated.

D_14C_basis.phase: earliest level of Sub-period IA (Joshi 1974, p. 36); the date list says only 'Chalcolithic culture'

parts.part: citadel (walled enclosure between two natural ridges)
parts.layout_phase: Phase 2 of Dales's sequence in Operation A-A/1 (Levels 10A, 10, 9 and 8)

towns.date_part: citadel (walled enclosure between two natural ridges)
towns.date_source: No source dates the enclosure; the published spans (Dales 1977, 1992; Pakistan heritage database) are general Harappan-period ranges. No date: the town does not enter scoring.
towns.D_14C_basis: no layout-phase determination with a 5568-year age in the dating record
